carrierIntegration.lvStep8Desc: Attach the scanned labels and cover sheet as PDFs, then send your application email to FedEx.
carrierIntegration.lvStep9Desc: Once FedEx approves your application, international shipping will be available on your production account. Approval typically takes 2-5 business days.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuideIntro: FedEx integration has two stages: 'API connection (no review required)' and 'Label issuance (review required)'. API connection is typically completed the same day.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Title: Part 1: API Connection — No Review Required
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Intro: Get the API keys required for integration from FedEx Developer Portal and register them in SalesAnchor.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step1Title: Log in to FedEx Developer Portal
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step1Desc: Log in to Developer Portal with your existing FedEx account to start setting up the API integration.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step2Title: Create a project on Developer Portal
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step3Desc: Add Rate, Service Availability, Pickup Request, and Ship APIs to your project.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step4Title: Register Sandbox keys in the app
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step4Desc: Enter your API key, secret key, and account number in the Sandbox section of the API Settings tab.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step5Title: Register production keys in the app
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step5Desc: Enter your API key, secret key, and account number in the Production section of the API Settings tab.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart1Step6Desc: Open the 'API Settings' tab at the top of this page and use the 'Test connection' button to verify the connection.
carrierIntegration.fedexGuidePart2Intro: To issue real labels using the FedEx Ship API, you need FedEx Label Validation approval. Follow the steps below to prepare your application.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideIntro: Walk through the FedEx account connection and the letterhead / signature registration used for paperless trade, one step at a time.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1Title: Log in to FedEx Developer Portal
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1Desc: Log in to <portalLink>FedEx Developer Portal</portalLink> with your FedEx account.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_1: Log in to developer.fedex.com, open "My Projects", and click "+ Create API Project". Select an existing project if you have one.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_2: Under "What do you need the APIs for?", select "I need to ship with FedEx and integrate FedEx APIs into my system".
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_3: In Step 1 "Select APIs", choose "Shipping, Rates, and other APIs", then enable all four: Ship / Rates and Transit Times / Pickup Request / ★Trade Documents Upload (required for ETD).
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_4: In Step 2 "Configuration", enter a project name (optional) and set Country/Territory to Japan.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_5: In Step 3 "Review", confirm all 4 APIs are included and Country/Territory is Japan. Agree to the terms and click "Create".
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_6: Your API project overview page is ready. Note your API Key / Secret Key / Account Number.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_6b: Confirm all 4 APIs are showing "Active" status.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_7: Now enter the test credentials you obtained from the FedEx portal into SalesAnchor. Paste your API Key and Secret Key into the form below and click "Save and Test".
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep2Desc: Add Ship API and the Trade Documents Upload API required for ETD to your project.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep2TradeDocumentsNote: Make sure to add Trade Documents Upload API. Without it, you cannot upload the letterhead and signature.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep3Desc: Register the API key, secret, and account number.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep1_7Cta: Test key setup is complete. Please proceed to Step 2.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideConnectionHint: Save the credentials, run the connection test, then come back here to continue.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideStep4Desc: Upload the company letterhead and signature image printed on invoices.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideConstraints: Based on FedEx guidance, the letterhead and signature images can be reused indefinitely in principle.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideCompleteDesc: The FedEx ETD setup is complete. Electronic documents will be attached automatically during shipment.
carrierIntegration.fedexEtdGuideIncompleteDesc: Some steps are still incomplete. Go back and review the previous steps.
